lessons.name: Vitest Setup & Configuration
lessons.desc: vite.config.ts test config, test environment (node vs jsdom), globals, setupFiles, coverage providers (v8 vs istanbul)

lessons.name: Describe, It, Expect
lessons.desc: Test structure, assertion matchers (toBe, toEqual, toContain, toThrow, toMatchSnapshot), test.each for table-driven tests

lessons.name: Mocking with vi
lessons.desc: vi.fn(), vi.spyOn(), vi.mock(), vi.importMock(), mockReturnValue, mockResolvedValue, mockImplementation, clearing mocks

lessons.name: Async Testing
lessons.desc: async/await in tests, resolves/rejects matchers, fake timers (vi.useFakeTimers), vi.advanceTimersByTime, waitFor

lessons.name: Code Coverage
lessons.desc: v8 coverage, coverage thresholds, lcov reports, which lines/branches to cover, what NOT to test (config, types, trivial getters)

lessons.name: Test Organisation & Lifecycle
lessons.desc: beforeEach, afterEach, beforeAll, afterAll, test.skip, test.only, test.todo, describe nesting, test isolation

lessons.name: RTL Philosophy — Test Behaviour, Not Implementation
lessons.desc: "The more your tests resemble the way your software is used, the more confidence they give you." Avoid testing state, class names, internal functions.

lessons.name: Queries & Priority
lessons.desc: getByRole (highest priority), getByLabelText, getByPlaceholderText, getByText, getByTestId (last resort). ByRole + accessible name.

lessons.name: user-event vs fireEvent
lessons.desc: @testing-library/user-event simulates real browser behaviour (focus, pointer, keyboard). fireEvent is lower-level. Always prefer user-event.

lessons.name: Async Queries & waitFor
lessons.desc: findBy* queries (async, wait for element), waitFor(callback), waitForElementToBeRemoved, act() wrapping.

lessons.name: Mocking Modules in RTL
lessons.desc: Mocking child components, mocking React Router, mocking context providers, wrapping with custom render function.

lessons.name: Accessibility Testing
lessons.desc: @axe-core/react, toHaveNoViolations, aria-label, role queries as accessibility validation, jest-axe integration.

lessons.name: MSW Setup (Node + Browser)
lessons.desc: setupServer() for Node/Vitest, setupWorker() for browser. Handler registration. server.listen() / worker.start().

lessons.name: Request Handlers
lessons.desc: http.get, http.post, http.put, http.delete. HttpResponse. Matching by URL, path params, query params.

lessons.name: Response Scenarios
lessons.desc: Success responses, error responses (4xx, 5xx), network errors (HttpResponse.error()), delays (delay utility)

lessons.name: Handler Overrides
lessons.desc: server.use() for one-off overrides in a single test. server.resetHandlers() to restore defaults. One-time handlers.

lessons.name: GraphQL Mocking
lessons.desc: graphql.query, graphql.mutation, graphql.link — mocking GraphQL operations by name. Variables inspection.

lessons.name: Sharing Handlers Across Test & Dev
lessons.desc: handlers.ts shared between Vitest, Playwright, and browser dev mode. Single source of truth for API mocks.

lessons.name: Playwright Setup & Configuration
lessons.desc: playwright.config.ts, projects (chromium/firefox/webkit), baseURL, retries, workers, reporter (HTML, GitHub)

lessons.name: Locators & Best Practices
lessons.desc: getByRole, getByLabel, getByText, getByTestId. Auto-waiting. Chaining. Filtering. Avoiding brittle CSS selectors.

lessons.name: Page Object Model
lessons.desc: Encapsulate page interactions in classes. Reusable, maintainable E2E tests. BasePage, LoginPage, DashboardPage.

lessons.name: Test Hooks & Fixtures
lessons.desc: test.beforeEach, test.afterEach, test.use, global setup/teardown, Playwright fixtures for auth state reuse.

lessons.name: Visual Regression Testing
lessons.desc: expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(), updateSnapshots, pixelDiff threshold, masking dynamic content, per-test snapshots.

lessons.name: API Mocking in Playwright
lessons.desc: page.route() to intercept and mock network requests. Combining MSW with Playwright. Seeding test data via API.

lessons.name: Test-Driven Development (TDD)
lessons.desc: Red → Green → Refactor. Writing tests before code. When TDD adds value and when it slows you down. London vs Detroit school.

lessons.name: Testing Architecture
lessons.desc: Testing pyramid, testing trophy, when to use unit vs integration vs E2E. The cost of each type. Avoiding the ice cream cone.

lessons.name: CI/CD Testing Pipeline
lessons.desc: GitHub Actions test workflow, parallelism, caching node_modules, failing fast, test reporting, PR status checks.

lessons.name: Contract Testing with Pact
lessons.desc: Consumer-driven contract tests. Defining API contracts between frontend and backend. Preventing breaking changes.

lessons.name: Performance Testing
lessons.desc: Lighthouse CI in tests, bundle size assertions (size-limit), Playwright performance metrics, web-vitals in E2E.

lessons.name: Test Maintenance & Flakiness
lessons.desc: Flaky test detection, quarantining, retry strategies, test determinism, eliminating timing-dependent tests.
